name: Lattice
summary: HR / people-management platform (Lattice). For agents it runs a first-party MCP server at api.latticehq.com/mcp: under the user's own Lattice login, Claude, ChatGPT and Slack read and write across performance reviews, weekly updates, feedback, goals, 1:1s and Grow, plus admin tools for review packets, calibration and CSV exports. A keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-15. Engagement surveys are listable and raw responses exportable as CSV, but no tool turns open-text comments into themes; that is the connected model's act. Per-seat pricing is published; $4,000 annual minimum.

payments.notes: lattice.com/pricing (200, 2026-11-15) publishes per-seat monthly prices (figures such as $13 and $8 per seat for a base product and Engagement; Grow and Compensation as add-ons) and states "The minimum annual agreement is $4,000." Sales-assisted annual contract, not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. Fixed public endpoint https://api.latticehq.com/mcp; a keyless initialize returned 401 with a Bearer challenge on 2026-11-15, its protected-resource metadata naming api-auth.latticehq.com as the OAuth2 server. Sign-in is the user's Lattice credentials; an admin enables the connector.
